transplant_recurrence.donor_recipient_distinguishable: Not from methylation; living-donor controls are separate people, not paired donor-recipient samples. Genotype-based donor fraction would need raw reads (controlled).

transplant_recurrence.main_risk: Controlled access only; the only post-transplant HCC recurrence cfDNA methylation set found. Counts are paper-stated, not repository-verified (provisional).

structured_output.summary: Category 1 (transplant/recurrence): nothing public with raw data. The only HCC-after-transplant cfDNA methylation set is the Toronto cfMeDIP cohort (57 LT + 32 resection, 112 follow-ups; EGAS50000000450, controlled). The Georgetown liver-transplant cfDNA set (GSE262273, 44 recipients, 130 serial samples) covers allograft injury, not HCC; raw reads sit in dbGaP phs003610 (controlled). Graft-recurrence tumour methylation: none found. Category 2 (public raw, HCC vs healthy plasma): best are GSE63775 (MCTA-seq, HCC 36/cirrhosis 16/healthy 39, 139 GB), GSE93203 (padlock BS, HCC 1,221/healthy 970, 142 GB), GSE149438 (HCC 43/normal 46, 263 GB), GSE124775 (HCC 38/HBV 19/healthy 58, 19 GB). Raw-IDAT plasma arrays: GSE129374 (450K, 22 cirrhosis+HCC vs 22 cirrhosis, no healthy, 0.56 GB) and held GSE298812. 5hmC sets (GSE112679 has no per-sample diagnosis in GEO; GSE81314; GSE89570) are 5hmC, not 5mC. Category 3 (longitudinal): Toronto (controlled) only; GSE93203 has serial samples per the paper but they are not labelled in GEO. No pre-diagnostic HCC plasma set found.

deviations: Toronto cohort (EGAS50000000450) counts come from the paper abstract and GitHub README, not a repository query; EGA metadata and file sizes were not queried, so those counts are provisional.
GSE93203 longitudinal status comes from the paper figure legend only; GEO metadata cannot confirm which runs are follow-ups (provisional).
GSA-Human HRA004780 and the HBMV study (PMC13108919) come from web search only; neither was queried in the repository.
The first SRA runinfo pull for GSE93203 was truncated at 1,691 runs; a re-query by SRP gave 2,191 runs and 141.7 GB, and those are the figures reported.
GEO free-text searches were capped at 500 hits per query (all queries returned fewer than that); SRA strategy search was capped at 5,000 of 5,069 hits.
